currentParagraphText: “I could do that... though I’m still considering just getting rid of it for good,” Jake sighed.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “I could do that... though I’m still considering just getting rid of it for good,” Jake sighed.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Understandable in some ways, but I would heavily advise against it. Think about it like this: the Bloodline was powerful, of that, there is no doubt. It only makes sense the item has some powerful function, too, right? If you can identify those functions, I have a little item here you may just be able to use to empower them. Once you do that, you can use the Starlight Heart to create something truly useful.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “It does,” the god nodded in confirmation. “It will for everyone, I’d reckon. Besides anyone who actually has the Bloodline, that is, but considering the grand total of people like that is zero, no one will be able to see what it does simply through Identify. It will require experimentation... or for you to eat it using the special stomach of Palate to learn more about it in a safe way.”
